title: GPT-5.2 takes the large-model route
summary:
GPT-5.2 took over the large-model route, Pollen checkout buttons were restored after a pause, and two community image tools joined the listings.

`openai-large` moved from GPT-4.1 to GPT-5.2, with a 16,384-token completion cap. `openai-reasoning` and `gpt-5.2-reasoning` now alias that same model. Separately, `openai` maps to GPT-5 Mini instead of Nano; `openai-fast` remains on Nano.

The $5, $10, $20, and $50 purchase buttons were temporarily disabled during an investigation, then re-enabled with their checkout packs. The temporary balance-panel warning was also removed. These changes did not alter how credits are applied.

The project listings added Aqua AI Generator, a Discord image bot with model choices, reference images, and remixing, and NextGenTools, which helps prepare generated and vectorized images for stock submission.

highlights.title: GPT-5.2 for large requests
highlights.text: Use `openai-large` for GPT-5.2, with completions capped at 16,384 tokens. `openai-reasoning` and `gpt-5.2-reasoning` now point to the same model. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-large).

highlights.title: GPT-5 Mini on openai
highlights.text: `openai` now routes to GPT-5 Mini instead of GPT-5 Nano. If you want Nano, `openai-fast` still uses it. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai).
